booking.instructions: Book online through the Acrew patient portal, call (262) 784-7770, or leave your details here and we'll follow up by email.

demo_chips: Can I get dental implants here?
Do you help patients without insurance?
fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can reach Honest Teeth Dentistry at (262) 784-7770 or FrontDesk@honestteeth.com, or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up.

faqs.a: Yes - Dr. Max Meinerz and Dr. Kyle Krueger place dental implants and implant-supported dentures right here in Elm Grove. It starts with an assessment of your oral health and medical history to confirm implants are right for you. Call (262) 784-7770 to schedule a consultation.

You're covered either way - alongside insurance and financing options, Honest Teeth offers a Dental Health Savings Club for patients without traditional coverage. Call (262) 784-7770 or email FrontDesk@honestteeth.com and the team will walk you through the best fit for your budget.
faqs.q: What if I don't have insurance?

faqs.a: Yes - we're always happy to accept new patients, whether it's been six months or several years since your last visit. Book online through the patient portal or call (262) 784-7770.
Your care team is led by Dr. Max Meinerz and Dr. Kyle Krueger, family dentists here in Elm Grove - both highly experienced in restorative dentistry, implants, and Invisalign.
Yes - we provide gentle, patient-centered care for adults, kids, and families, all in one Elm Grove location.
faqs.q: Do you see kids and families?

faqs.a: Through the Acrew patient portal you can schedule online, pay your bill without calling the office, and update your forms and information from home before your visit.
faqs.q: What can I do in the patient portal?

pricing.summary: Every mouth is different, so Honest Teeth doesn't publish a one-size price list - your dentist explains your options and the costs clearly before any treatment, and we offer financing plus a Dental Health Savings Club. Call (262) 784-7770 or leave your name and email here and the team will follow up.
